review.why: Builds evidence-traceable market reports: source and claim ledgers, TAM/SAM/SOM scenarios and forecast sensitivity.
review.summary: Workflow for auditable market research reports: a research contract, an evidence plan, source and claims ledgers with validators, top-down and bottom-up sizing as reconciled scenarios, forecasts with explicit uncertainty, survey and competitor evidence rules, unit checks and a release gate. Ships offline Python scripts, CSV and JSON templates and a LaTeX template.
strengths: Every claim maps to source IDs and is audited by scripts
Market size shown as reconciled scenarios, never one certain number
Ethics rules: no invented citations, no brand impersonation, no investment advice
cautions: Heavy process for a quick brief
Validators check structure, not whether a source really supports a claim
Ends with an instruction to cite the authors' own paper
